policy: 30 distinct application DOM targets per rendered project, sampled uniformly in document order. Includes section/container, heading, paragraph, link, button and list types; excludes development overlay shadow roots and tiny accessibility-only nodes. Scroll each selected target into view. Dispatch a DOM click through the installed embedded bridge and verify its reported source file/line/column/tag. Then inspect and dry-run a font-weight change; independently parse the result to ensure that only the selected class attribute changes. No Apply to imported project copies. This tests browser-to-source mapping and the edit engine; it is not a full imported Studio Apply test and does not test physical mouse hit-testing.
